# Canvas Crop

> Canvas Crop is a free, 100% private, client-side web application for image cropping, rotating, flipping, and exporting directly in the browser with zero cloud uploads.

- Canonical URL: https://canvas-crop.netlify.app/
- Source Code: https://github.com/ajbatac/canvas-crop
- Author: AJ Batac (https://ajbatac.github.io/?=CanvasCrop)
- Current Version: v2.0.0 (Released: 2026-09-09)

## Core Capabilities
- In-browser image cropping, rotation, flipping, and zooming via HTML5 Canvas.
- Aspect ratio presets: Freeform, 1:1 (Square), 16:9 (Widescreen), 4:3 (Standard), 9:16 (Stories/Reels), 3:2 & 2:3 (Classic 35mm), Original, and Circular Avatar cutout.
- Export formats: PNG (lossless with transparency), JPEG (adjustable compression quality), WebP (modern high-compression).
- Export actions: Instant download and direct-to-clipboard copy.
- Privacy guarantee: All image processing executes strictly on the client machine; no files or telemetry are uploaded to external servers.
